title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for evaluation of chronic back discomfort.

History of Present Illness
Patient reports that the back discomfort has been a persistent issue for approximately six months, which is currently rated 5/10 in severity. The pain is worse with prolonged sitting and improves with gentle stretching. Patient denies any recent trauma or exacerbating events. He reports occasional stiffness in the morning that resolves within an hour of getting out of bed. He states he has continued his usual activity level despite the discomfort.

Medication List
Current medications reviewed include: lisinopril, multivitamin, and sertraline.

Exam
Vitals are stable. Abdomen is soft and non-tender. Musculoskeletal exam reveals mild tenderness over the lumbar paraspinal muscles without objective signs of acute radiculopathy on movement testing. Gait is steady.

Assessment
Chronic lumbar discomfort requiring ongoing management.

Plan
Continue with current conservative management plan, emphasizing core strengthening exercises. Patient is advised to schedule a follow-up in three months or sooner if symptoms significantly worsen. Continue all medications listed on the medication list, including sertraline.
explanations: An antidepressant on the list does not establish major depression; coders do not infer diagnoses from medications.

distractors.why: Only the provider can document a diagnosis.
